|translation='''Title:''' The Shield Doors Must Be Closed.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on the boundary between Echo Docking Bay and the innermost marker location. Under nighttime conditions, movement between Echo Docking Bay and other locations except Echo Base is not allowed.

'''Lore:'''
Princess, nothing more can be done tonight. The shield doors must close now.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is エフェクト.
